 Description
Product Details:
Neware CT-4000 battery testing system was launched in 2008 and is one of the most popular battery testing systems around the world. ISO9001:2015 certified, CT-4008T Multi Range A Battery Testing System, characterized with 0.05% FS accuracy and down to mA capability, enables users to perform DCIR tests, dQ/dV and other basic tests on three-electrode system. It has eight channels which has independent constant-current and constant-voltage source, programmed and controlled by computer software. It is designated for cylindrical and pouch cell testing in battery R&D and manufacturing lab. Due to its rapid data acquisition frequency, it also can be applied to super capacitor or EDLC (Electronic Double Layer Capacitor) test.
Product Features:
Four current ranges:
Range 1: 0.5mA~100mA 
Range 2: 100mA ~500mA
Range 3: 500mA ~ 3A
Range 4: 3A ~ 6A
Accuracy: 0.05% FS
Rise time: ≤1ms
Minimum plus width: 500mS
Neware CT-4008T battery test system includes a main test unit and a mid machine. The mid machine can control up to 10 main test units. 
About Neware
Since 1998, Neware has been committed to providing world-class testing solutions for the batteries and capacitors. Neware has provided flexible, high accuracy battery testing equipment to more than 32,000 customers worldwide ranging from battery manufacturers to R&D institutes, such as Argonne National Lab, LG Chem, Johnson Matthey, 3M, MIT, Stanford University and Princeton University. Customers are satisficed with stable, cost-effective battery testing equipment, along with the great service of Neware. ISO9001:2015 certified.
MSE Supplies is an authorized distributor of Neware in the USA. The product figure is for reference only. The actual product may look different based on the product configuration. 
MSE Supplies is a US-based leading supplier of battery research materials and equipment with thousands of customers worldwide.

FAQ
1. What is middle machine?
A: The middle machine is used to communicate between PC and cyclers. You will need at least one middle machine to run the testers.
2. How many cyclers can a middle machine connect?
A: One middle machine can connect up to 10 cyclers.
3. I have a middle machine already. Can I use my old middle machine?
A: Some middle machines are old versions which are not compatible with new cyclers. Please email us to check if your middle machine version works with your new cycler.
4. Is middle machine the same for all types of cyclers? or do I need to buy different type of middle machine to run different cyclers.
A: There is only one type of middle machine. It can connect 5V10mA, 5V20mA, 5V50mA, 5V6A and 5V12A cyclers
